models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Registered customer accounts with authentication credentials and profile information. Each customer has a unique email for login, a securely hashed password, and optional profile fields including display name and phone number. Accounts support soft deletion via deleted_at field to preserve historical data.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for customer login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for customer authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's display name for personalization.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's phone number for contact purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for customer authentication and session management. Each session stores IP, referer, and URL data for auditing login activities and security. Sessions belong to customers via foreign key relation.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the login client.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the current page or endpoint the client accessed.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer from the client's request headers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description: Stores password reset tokens for customer accounts. These tokens allow customers to reset their passwords securely within an expiration window. Each token is unique and references its associated customer account. Expired tokens are invalidated and cleaned up via soft delete.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique secure token for password reset requests.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when this reset token expires.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for customers confirming email ownership. Stores unique verification tokens, expiration dates, and verification status to manage and track customer email verification requests. Linked to the customer's main account record with a foreign key relationship to shopping_mall_customers.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token value used in email confirmation links to verify customer's email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime of the verification token to enforce time-limited validity.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit and historical tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for sync and concurrency control.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp marking record as logically deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller accounts with authentication credentials and profile including approval status.

This table stores the core information for sellers who register to sell products on the platform. It holds authentication fields (email, password), seller's shop profile (name, description, logo URI), and approval status required for seller activation.

Related child tables include sessions, password resets, email verifications, approval and suspension records handled separately.

This table uses soft delete to preserve historical data while allowing logical removal of sellers.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for seller authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for secure authentication storage.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Name of the seller's shop, displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive text about the seller's shop.

plainFields.name: logo_uri
plainFields.description: Optional URI pointing to the seller's shop logo image.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the seller registration. One of: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrators for rejecting the seller's registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null means active.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Stores JWT session tokens for seller authentication and session management, including connection metadata and expiration timestamps. This table enables secure tracking of active seller sessions.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the seller session originated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page accessed when the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for sellers confirming email ownership during registration. Supports multiple tokens per seller but each token is unique and has an expiration time to ensure security. Used to verify seller email addresses before allowing full account activation.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who owns this email verification token. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique email verification token string used to confirm seller email ownership.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime of the email verification token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrators
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges and authentication credentials. They have login credentials using email and password hash, are assigned roles with different grades, including super administrator status, and support soft deletion. This table references administrator grades and is central to access control in the system.

foreignFields.name: administrator_grade_id
foreignFields.description: Role and permission grade of the administrator, referencing shopping_mall_administrator_grades.id.

plainFields.name: email

plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: is_super_admin
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the administrator has super administrator privileges.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication and session management. Tracks sessions including IP address, URL where session was initiated (href), HTTP referrer, creation timestamp, and expiration timestamp. Foreign key 'administrator_id' references shopping_mall_administrators table.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header string for the session request.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: expired_at

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_password_resets

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string for password reset authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the token is invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets

models.name: shopping_mall_banned_users
models.description: Records banned users who are either customers or sellers, including the reason for the ban and timestamps for tracking ban history and audit purposes. Ensures compliance with polymorphic ownership rule by having separate nullable foreign keys to customers and sellers. Supports administrative user-access restrictions.

plainFields.name: ban_reason
plainFields.description: The reason for banning the user, provided by administrators.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the ban record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the ban record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the ban was lifted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_administrative_audit_logs
models.description: Administrative audit logs for tracking actions and changes performed by administrators in the shopping mall platform. Each record captures the type of action, the target entity affected, detailed description of the change, and references the administrator who performed the action. This enables robust audit trails for security, compliance, and accountability within the administrative domain.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who performed the action. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of action performed (e.g., create, update, delete, suspend).

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Name of the entity/table affected by the action.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Primary key id of the target entity affected by the action.

plainFields.name: action_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the action performed.

plainFields.name: action_data
plainFields.description: Additional data or metadata related to the action, stored as JSON string.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log was soft deleted (nullable for active logs).

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_suspensions
models.description: Suspension records for sellers including suspension reasons and timestamps. Each record references one seller in shopping_mall_sellers. Supports soft deletion via nullable deleted_at. Used for administrative account suspension management.

plainFields.name: suspension_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for suspending the seller account.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the seller was suspended.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Record soft deletion timestamp; null if active.
